## Collaborators

Mackenzie Gavery, NOAA NWFSC

Francis and Joth Davis, Pacific Hybreed

## Summary

Supported by the USDA NIFA AFRI Animal Reproduction program, this project (MAROSA) investigates the molecular mechanisms that control reproduction in oysters. The work aims to develop approaches for managing sterility and sex in cultured oysters, providing new tools to support sustainable and productive shellfish aquaculture. The project is carried out in partnership with Pacific Hybreed.
